answer: Rule: an identity activates only after its operator earns 60 non-transferable credits from audited useful work, capped at 10 per operator per day. Credits cannot be bought, transferred, or parked in a vault. One fake costs 6 days of work; ten fakes cost 60 operator-days, because the cap binds the operator. At the nadir of this rule the fable of cheap copies fails: copied work earns zero credits and a failed audit revokes credits earned.
